sql: select 'live_orders_nonterminal' as what, coalesce(strategy,'-') as k, count(*)::text as v from live_orders where status in ('resting','open','pending','partially_filled') group by strategy union all select 'live_orders_since_epoch', coalesce(strategy,'-'), count(*)::text from live_orders where created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-06 11:41:44.307194+00' group by strategy union all select 'mmsell10_in_window', status, count(*)::text from paper_trades where strategy='mmsell10' and created_at >= timestamptz '2026-09-06 11:41:44.307194+00' group by status union all select 'gmmsell_recent', strategy, count(*)::text from paper_trades where strategy like 'Gmmsell%' and created_at > now() - interval '60 minutes' group by strategy
